deficiencies.description: The rewrite interprets the lecturer's pointing gestures ('You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus') as a specific anatomical relationship ('The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus').
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus, which normally has a very thin muscle wall.

deficiencies.description: The term 'circumspect' was replaced with 'circumscribed' without an entry in the corrections list.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour is therefore circumscribed and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.

deficiencies.description: The rewrite omits the statement that adjacent lymph nodes are sampled 'very often'.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: very often, for example, with breast cancers, you might sample the adjacent lymph node
deficiencies.rewritePassage: as for example with breast cancers, the adjacent lymph node might be sampled

considerations.sourcePassage: and has, if you like, invaded within this tissue.
considerations.reason: The phrase 'if you like' was appropriately rendered as 'in a sense' without changing the meaning.

considerations.sourcePassage: Movable, and literally, you can scoop it out with no damage to the surrounding tissue. All right? So a benign tumor.
considerations.reason: Omission of conversational check 'All right?' and consolidation of phrasing into textbook prose are allowed changes.
